abstract.t: This document describes the high-level architecture for Agent Resource Discovery (ARD), an open, federated framework for publishing, indexing, discovering, and invoking software agent capabilities (such as Model Context Protocol servers, Agent-to-Agent agents, programmatic skills, and web APIs) across local networks, enterprise domains, and the public Internet. It defines the system roles, deployment topologies, core architectural principles, and end- to-end interaction flows that connect the ARD specifications for establishing Initial Contact and the Discovery Interface for capability lookup in the ARD catalog. The Registration interface will be specified in a later document.
